author: reek
body: The abstract resource lifecycle. Every managed entity in the system is a Resource: files, disks, USB devices, services, ports, fleet nodes, servers, deployments. A Resource has identity, status, a set of capabilities (what you can do to it), and a set of properties (what you can read from it). Managers are just typed collections of Resources with a domain-specific query surface.

author: reek
body: This chapter is the foundation. The individual managers cite it and specialize it. The monitor binds to it. The shell renders it.
